items.quote: Did you know that 94% of salespeople quit trying after the fourth call, even though 60% of all sales are made after that point?
items.statement: 94% of salespeople quit trying after the fourth call, even though 60% of all sales are made after that point.

items.quote: First of all, remember that with every contact with a potential client, you have nothing to lose and everything to gain by asking again.
items.statement: Remember that with every contact with a potential client, you have nothing to lose and everything to gain by asking again.

items.quote: But what if I told you that rejection can be transformed into a powerful tool for success?
items.statement: Rejection can be transformed into a powerful tool for success.

items.quote: Qualify the person and make sure you speak to every decision-maker at the table.
items.statement: Qualify the person and make sure you speak to every decision-maker at the table.

items.quote: make a list of things you want in life but haven't asked for. Write down how you stop yourself from asking and what fears you are escaping from.
items.statement: Make a list of things you want in life but haven't asked for and identify what stops you from asking.

overview: Insights into handling rejection in sales and personal growth strategies.
